Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The Move Over Law is described twice: the rules of the road chapter presents changing lanes or slowing down as equal choices, while this chapter says slowing in your lane is allowed only when a lane change is unsafe; only this chapter's stricter version is taught (verify TN-INTER-D-MOVEOVER) [A05].
Breakdown advice differs: the parking chapter says tie a handkerchief to the left door handle or antenna and stay in the car, while this chapter says tie a white cloth to the hood or antenna and wait in or near the car away from traffic; this chapter's version is taught here (verify TN-INTER-D-BREAKDOWN) [A05].
The emergency kit list prints fuses where road flares are evidently meant; it is taught as reflectors or flares [A06].
The interchange diagrams were not used; only the step text beside them was taught.
